contexts.text: With such, the callosity appears... striated within. (Compare HH 466.)
It is then seen that they are only spotted streaks.
The influx of the Spirits of Mars was felt as a thin striped rain, which was a sign that they were not in the affection of truth and good; for this is represented by what is striped. See SE 3885.
The Africans appeared in striped garments of linen. They said that such garments correspond to them; and that their women have striped garments of silk. SE 6095.
They who have confirmed themselves in falsities, are like those who see the striations as on the wall; and in the shade of evening they see that striation as a rider, or a man...
The rays twinkled through the clouds in streaks.
Spiritual things are represented by... striated things.
Therefore such striated bodies are white; and, if they are striated very thinly, they are transparent.
The difference of Spirits as to spiritual and celestial things may be inferred from the cortical and striate things of the viscera.
In the vitreous humour there is a cortical, but not a striate substance. In the crystalline lens there are striae, but such as are harder. In other viscera in like manner, Explained.
In the speech of the celestial... there is nothing harsh or stripy, that is, noisy.
As soon as there is in it anything stripy, that is, not so flowing... it is not accordant, and a Spirit does not acknowledge it as true; but at once notices discrepancies.
The Angels of the interior Heaven, when represented to Spirits, appear to them in... a garment with white and black neatly mingled almost in stripes.
When their interior affections, which are good, fall into this (sensuous state)... their beard appears to them... in little bunches, that is, striped.
Communication with Heaven seemed to be taken away, which appeared like streaks of light being elevated from him.
When this Hell was opened, there appeared a striped snowiness being elevated on high... This striped snowiness was that which exhaled from those pernicious deceits mingled with apparent good.
